content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison script for vertical horizontal-velocity structure at wave periods 2.5, 3, and 6 s. It selects a result directory and horizontal sample index by period (L11-L34), computes linear-theory velocity versus depth from a dispersion wavenumber (L42-L54), reconstructs 10-level FUNWAVE U and V profiles from depth, eta, depth-averaged velocity, and Ax/Ay/Bx/By coefficients (L58-L86), plots U at one grid cell against theory, and writes plots/compare.jpg (L88-L118).

unresolved: Control-flow initialization defect across L16-L34: m0 is assigned only for periods 2.5, 3, 6, or 9. If period is extended to any other value, the first such iteration uses m0 before assignment or a later iteration silently reuses the previous period's m0. There is no default/error branch.
The period==9 branch at L31-L34 is unreachable with the configured period vector at L3, leaving its alternate file/index path untested in this execution.
Potential range errors across L38, L88, and L91: fixed indices n0=25 and m0 up to 1148 are used without checking n>=n0 and m>=m0.
Interface/shape assumptions across L62-L69 and L78-L85 are unchecked: all loaded fields must match dep, or elementwise reconstruction/indexing fails.
mask is loaded at L63 but never applied, while U at L84 is plotted at a fixed cell at L91; a dry or invalid cell can therefore contribute a profile despite the available mask.
V is fully reconstructed at L85 but never consumed, so its computation and all v/Ay/By inputs do not affect the output figure.
